summary: Solventum Corp filed an 8-K reporting the resolution of a stockholder bylaw challenge in Delaware Court. The company agreed to pay $120,000 in attorneys' fees and expenses to settle a moot action over advance notice provisions, which were amended in September 2024. No merger, tender, or strategic transaction is involved; the filing merely provides court-ordered notice of the fee payment. Terms: $120,000 total, no per-share price or premium. No board recommendation or advisor named. Structure: stipulation and order closing case. Watch for no further litigation; no risk-arb angle.
